title: Solo Crisis
overview:
Guide Your Followers and Strike the Demon's Stronghold!

When the front becomes a mountain, the back becomes a valley: a new kind of simulation where the front and back are one! In this world you become a god and face off against the demon who controls monsters in the world on the other side. Guide your followers chosen from the front-side world (leader, warrior, archer, laborer, magician, priest), overcome obstacles with the power of miracles, and destroy the demon's temple!

シモベを導き、悪魔の本拠地を叩け!

表が山になれば裏では谷になる、新感覚の表裏一体型シミュレーション!この世界であなたは神となり、裏側の世界で魔物たちを操る悪魔と対決します。表側の世界から選ばれたシモべたち(指導者・戦士・弓兵・工民・魔法使い・僧侶)を導き、奇跡の力で障害を乗り越えて、悪魔の神殿を破壊しましょう!
